peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (65.9): 3.6 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 263 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 8). Initial resale-wave effect: 1 of the 4 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Oct 2024–Dec 2024); the sustained rate is shown separately. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 16.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: 3.1 resales per 100 homes a year over 21 months (Jan 2025–Sep 2026): higher than 211 of 388 similar developments. First resale wave from Jan 2024 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 1 earlier resale does not start the wave. Observed 24-month activity: 3.6.

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Orchard Boulevard MRT about 330 m, Orchard MRT about 660 m; closer than 378 of 551 similar developments (the same as 17). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest Alexandra Primary School about 970 m; more than 107 of 551 similar developments (the same as 202). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 8 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 570 m), more than 344 of 551 similar developments (the same as 74); nearest hawker centre Zion Riverside Food Centre about 1,060 m; nearest park Camp Road Interim Park about 740 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Upperhouse at Orchard Boulevard, 47 new sales, about 280 m; Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 380 m; Park Nova, 4 new sales, about 410 m; River Green, 34 new sales, about 1,030 m; Promenade Peak, 99 new sales, about 1,260 m; River Modern, 431 new sales, about 1,280 m; Zyon Grand, 637 new sales, about 1,380 m; The Avenir, 1 new sales, about 1,400 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 345 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,767 new sales and 1,174 resales (2,941 purchases); new sales were 60.1% of these purchases. Subsales (11) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,174 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 432 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,174 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,282 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−8.4%). Planning-area private resales −3.8%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
